source_evidence: Exact player 'Hold action to attack when an ally is in melee' uses V's R1 Ready action, trigger a conscious ally within5ft of an enemy in legal attack range. Under existing combat rules native Psychic Blade cannot be created through Ready reaction; DM selects V's already-owned reusable physical Galepierce Dart (doubled range40/120 vs ordinary dart20/60) to execute this requested ranged attack without adding V movement or finite resource spend, narrated through silver sword. V at(0,0), target D(0,25) within normal40 range and unobstructed; V keeps movement/BA unused. Fenar R1 initiative3 independently uses BA Rage4→3/4, chooses Beast Claws, moves20ft from(5,0) to(5,20) costing40 movement over difficult slope. Within5ft D under established diagonal convention, triggers V's readied reaction. Actual visible RNG receipt a8e0d150b8b2c7855611f990faf44f19 face13+9=22 hits AC16; Galepierce d4(4)+4=8 piercing plus eligible once-per-turn Sneak Attack2d6(2,4)=6 total14, D33→19HP. V reaction spent, dart physically at target, no Psi/MP/superiority/Action Surge. Fenar independently elects Reckless Attack, applies 2014 melee advantage until her next turn; Double-Claw Rend mechanically greataxe +8, adv19/17=27 HIT, d12(1)+STR5+Rage2=8 slashing D19→11; Beast Claw +9 (STR5/PB3/Insignia1), adv7/11=20 HIT, d6(6)+STR5+Insignia1+Rage2=14 slashing D11→0 dead. Actual visible receipt 5e32a6975fe011aa54a802c4a573ce1f; remaining additional claw attack has no reachable foe, no roll. No Shift or MP use. Fenar uninjured. Round2 Cirren initiative18 remains(-5,15) within60 of B(-15,60), casts Toll the Dead at unwounded B, WIS face13+0=13/DC16 FAIL, 2d8(8,7)=15 necrotic B13→0 dead; actual receipt569d6f2e8ee41575fa5618cb0737b085. Cirren can move SW20ft toward B but it is still10ft away, no extra attack or slot. All three encountered creatures dead, no further enemy actions. Immediate visible battlefield safe from these enemies; no claim entire fissure/refuge cleared. Under standing post-combat magical thrown-item recovery, V retrieves Galepierce Dart from D corpse in accessible hollow, no obstacles or check; returns to roadside group. Fenar ends Rage after danger ends, Cirren's nonconcentration Spiritual Weapon expires naturally by~11:01, no additional resource use. No loot/search of corpse, new passage entry, creature identity revelation, healing, reward, XP level-up, or further journey assumed. Cirren43/51 (8 prior R1 damage), V48/48, Fenar59/59. All horses and Mara healthy, no new physical damage. Day331~11:01, LR0/6 unchanged since R1 interruption, D331 full provision charge still pending. V chooses next action.
